newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares down after NATO disappointment.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares down after NATO disappointment.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 2.85 percent on Friday, extending their losses for the seventh session, following news that the U.S. would not support early membership in NATO for Slovenia.
"Our market is so depressed and illiquid that every piece of good or bad news has a big impact on prices," one broker said.
* The SBI index fell 36.23 points to 1,235.63.

* Drug maker Lek had the highest turnover, tumbling 8.97 percent to 22,030 tolars on volume of 867 shares for total turnover of 19.5 million tolars. * Brokerage Dadas led decliners, tumbling 9.37 percent to 7,160 tolars on volume of 29 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
